scripts.start: npx -y concurrently -n "ML,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "green,blue,magenta" --kill-others-on-fail "cd ml && python app.py" "cd backend && npm start" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -n "ML,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "green,blue,magenta" --kill-others-on-fail "cd ml && python app.py" "cd backend && npm start" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.install:all: npx -y concurrently "cd backend && npm install" "cd frontend && npm install"
